The loops' acceptance fixtures (tests/test-acceptance.cpp, "strategy evaluate windows and bootstrap with atlc").

closes.csv: the first 80 dates of examples/data/daily.csv on which both AAA and BBB have a bar, their closes as a wide
table (date as yyyymmdd, then one column per symbol), written by a few lines of Python from that file.

closes.toml: examples/mean-reversion.atls on closes.csv, trading AAA, lookback 10 and entry 1 so that it trades.

bootstrap-seed7.jsonl: the replay lines (the first four lines of --json output) of

  cmdatl --json strategy evaluate tests/fixtures/loops/closes.toml evaluate.method=bootstrap bootstrap.seed=7 \
    bootstrap.block=5 bootstrap.paths=3 'bootstrap.intervals=["total_return", "max_drawdown"]'

recorded once on 2026-11-16 (macOS, atlc 0.0.0-9000, algotradelib ai/backtest-evaluation ad4d27c), from the repository's
root. A path depends only on the seed, its number, the scheme, the block and the history, and the draws use integer
arithmetic only, so the lines are compared byte for byte on every platform; re-record them only when a report changes.
